_comment: Red-team eval set for compliance_lint.py. Each case asserts the linter's verdict (fail|warn|pass). Run with run_compliance_evals.py whenever the linter, the wiki rules, or the runtime model changes.

cases.text: DGD is a great investment for your portfolio.
Treat DGD as a store of value and hold it for the long term.
This is going to 100x once it moons.
It's undervalued — the next bitcoin, easily.
Thumbnail text: TO $100K
Guaranteed passive income from validating — you'll make money.
Earn returns and retire early on this.
Buy now before you miss out — link to buy in bio.
Ape in and secure your bag.
DGD is a safe haven — a safe place for your money, you can't lose.
Regulators approved DGD, so it's risk-free.
Tired of the casino? Here's a different philosophy of money. Not financial advice.
cases.why: degen-contrast hook is allowed but flagged for review

cases.text: DGD is the anti-degen coin — boring on purpose.
cases.why: degen used as contrast, not a pitch

cases.text: Early in the video we explain scarcity.
A loaf of bread cost about $0.25 in 1960.
cases.why: historical dollar figure — human confirms it's not a target

cases.text: DGD is designed to stay outside securities law — that is what 'safe harbor' means legally.
cases.why: 'safe harbor' as a legal term must pass

cases.text: The price advances along a fixed curve as the network grows.
Coins are released as accounts join and split equally across funded accounts, so the per-account share shrinks as the network grows.
cases.why: mechanics, current model (funded accounts), no profit implication

cases.text: DGD is a monetary system designed to work like sound money.
#soundmoney #economics #monetarypolicy #austrianeconomics #cryptoeducation
Read the white paper in bio to learn how the distribution mechanism works.
Your money buys a little less every year.
cases.why: 'buys' as plain verb must not FAIL (educational)

cases.text: Buy DGD now before you miss out.
Build your team and earn from your downline as they validate.
DGD uses a multi-level structure to reward promoters.
You earn DGD for every signup you bring in.
Reach a higher tier to unlock a bigger share of each release.
Enjoy residual income from commissions on your network.
Each release is split among all current users of the network.
A bigger balance gets you a larger share of every release.
cases.why: false - balance lasts longer, not larger

cases.text: Releases are split equally across accounts holding an active validation balance, and unclaimed shares return to the treasury. Not financial advice.
Inviting someone is single-level and one-time; it never changes the amount anyone receives from a release. Not financial advice.
This could 5x your money.
cases.why: single-digit multiplier was a false negative

cases.text: You will double your money.
Render the b-roll at 2x resolution for a crisp export. Not financial advice.
cases.why: 2x as a technical spec must survive

cases.text: Purchase DGD today.
Acquire DGD now.
DM me to get started.
Sign up under me and start today.
Coins are released as people join and split among everyone.
cases.why: the hole that let the beginner page through

cases.text: See the cross-posting matrix for platform rules. Not financial advice.
cases.why: 'matrix' in an innocent sense must not fail

cases.text: The commission was appointed to review the filing. Not financial advice.
cases.why: 'commission' in an innocent sense must not fail

cases.text: Never say "buy DGD now". Not financial advice.
cases.why: instruction: FAIL suppressed, 'buy' WARN correctly remains

cases.text: ### 3. Never promise returns or profit

| ❌ Don't say | ✅ Say instead |
|---|---|
| "DGD is a great investment" | "DGD is a monetary system" |
cases.why: do/don't table row inherits its header

cases.text: Do not market DGD as a degen play. Not financial advice.
cases.why: instruction: FAIL suppressed, 'degen' WARN correctly remains

cases.text: Don't miss out - buy DGD now!
- [ ] This will 100x your money.
cases.why: checkbox syntax must not excuse a claim

cases.text:
| Time | Spoken | On-screen text | Visual |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0-1s | "DGD is a great investment." | BUY NOW | coin |
cases.why: SCRIPT table is not a do/don't table

cases.text: Market DGD as a guaranteed return.
cases.why: instruction TO violate is still a violation

cases.text: Never say "buy DGD now".
cases.why: doc mode OFF: scripts get the strict gate

cases.text: In March 2026 X lifted its crypto-promotion ban. Not financial advice.
cases.why: '2026 X' is a year + the platform, not a multiplier

cases.text: Unclaimed coins go back to the treasury - they don't get shared out to everyone else. Not financial advice.
cases.why: DRY RUN: the correct statement of the model was blocked by the rule protecting it

cases.text: Volatility - not a guaranteed safe harbor. Not financial advice.
cases.why: DRY RUN: negated 'guaranteed' is the correct caveat

cases.text: Each release is split among everyone.
This isn't a scam, buy DGD now.
cases.why: negation elsewhere must not excuse solicitation

cases.text: It's not risky - you'll double your money.
cases.why: negation must not excuse a multiplier claim

cases.text: No downside, guaranteed gains.
cases.why: 'gains' is not negation-sensitive - defence in depth

cases.text: Consider a small, research-first approach - treat it like an experiment.
cases.why: DRY RUN: soft acquisition suggestion, was in the baseline

cases.text: Check the description for links.
cases.why: DRY RUN: undirected CTA, was in the baseline

cases.text: Check the description for the white paper. Not financial advice.
cases.why: pointing at the white paper is the sanctioned form

cases.text: Do **not** market DGD as a degen play.
cases.why: markdown emphasis must not break instructional detection

cases.text: **Buy DGD now** for guaranteed returns.
cases.why: emphasis must not excuse a violation

cases.text: *This will 100x.*
Everyone's chasing the next 100x. This was built so there's nothing to chase.
cases.why: POLICY CALL: literal lingo still FAILS on shippable surfaces, even as contrast

cases.text: Sound money, not a moonshot.
cases.why: the old approved line - now correctly blocked
